summary: Jet.AI Inc. filed an 8-K under Items 8.01 and 9.01 to report regaining compliance with Nasdaq's Minimum Bid Price Requirement after effecting a 1-for-200 reverse stock split on April 8, 2026. The filing notes no deficiencies remain. There are no deal terms, advisory or structural mechanics. The filing is a routine compliance update, not a special situation.
